_meta.product_source: /workspace/game/drink_unlocks.json (14 drinks; products.json from Programmer Master not yet present, ids to match)
_meta.tone: Cozy sitcom. Customers are kind. Off drinks get gentle, funny feedback and the customer still pays.
_meta.selection: Pick per_customer_product line if present, else 40% per_customer tier line, else product tier line.

legacy_product_ids.iced_lemonade: classic_lemonade (served with extra ice; heat-weather variant)
legacy_product_ids.sweet_coffee: black_coffee + sugar (no longer a menu item; nearest menu drinks: mocha, vanilla_latte)

_meta.alias_note: Tier was called 'poor' in v1; code (products.json quality.tiers) uses 'off'. Treat 'poor' as an alias of 'off'.
_meta.polish_note: Oct 23 warmth pass: off lines are gentle, funny and appreciative (3+ stars, always pays); fewer 'This is/I think/Tastes like' openers and 'Paying.' tails. See bark_style_notes.md.

great: Bold, smooth, not a hint of bitter. Perfect.
That's a proper cup. Marge would rate it five mile markers.
Strong enough to lift a couch. Thank you!
Rich and hot. My whole morning just straightened up.
Smooth, warm, just right. Goldilocks would move in.
okay: Gentle and honest. Warm hands, warm heart.
A bold little edge. I kind of like it.
Could stand one more scoop of beans. Still nice!
Solid. A dependable mid-size box of a coffee.
off: This coffee is... shy. Very shy. I'll cheer it on.
Beans' gentle cousin, this one. I like the whole family!
Coffee, as told by a friend of a friend. Great story. Thank you!
Bold choice, adding no bold. Here's your money, friend.
Extra bold! Like a pep talk from my favourite grumpy uncle. Love him.

great: Perfect foam. I could nap on it.
Silky milk, smooth shot. A hug in a cup.
Foam holds its shape like a good moving box. Wonderful.
Creamy, warm, balanced. You've got the touch.
That milk was steamed with love.
okay: Foam's a little flat, but the flavor's lovely.
Extra milky, extra cozy. I'll take it!
Could be a smidge hotter. I'll drink fast!
Nice! The shot's a little quiet under all that milk.
off: The foam took the day off. Fair enough, honestly.
Milk with a whispered rumor of espresso. I love a good rumor!
Cozy-warm, not hot-warm. My hands are happy. Here you go.
Milk and coffee are still getting to know each other. Sweet first date!
Flat as a packed box, and I love a good box. Sipping happily!

great: Sweet and sour in perfect harmony!
A summer afternoon in a cup. Wow.
Fresh-squeezed, you can tell. Wonderful.
Just enough pucker. Bright and happy.
That's a front-porch lemonade. Perfect.
okay: Needs a squeeze more lemon, but it's sweet!
Bit sour! My face did a little dance.
Light and breezy. Very refreshing!
Good! A pinch more sugar and it's legendary.
off: Sugar water with lemony daydreams. Sweetest daydream I've had!
My whole face folded up. Like a cardboard box! Thanks!
So refreshing it's practically a spa day. Hydrated and happy!
So sour I can hear colors! What a ride. Thank you!
The lemon's playing hide-and-seek. I'll keep sipping till I find it!

great: Pink as a sunset and twice as sweet. Perfect!
The berry splash is just right. Biscuit would approve.
It's so pretty I almost didn't drink it. Almost.
okay: A little more lemon than berry today. Still cheerful!
Pale pink. Shy pink. I like shy.
Berry's hiding at the bottom. Fun surprise for the last sip!
off: Ruby-red instead of pink. Very dramatic! I'm a fan of drama.
The berries threw a party! Lemons can come next time. Fun!
It's pink-ish. In the right light. I'll bring a lamp. Here you go!

great: Tea and lemon holding hands. Lovely.
Cooled just right. Tastes like the sun coming back.
Smooth tea, bright lemon. A rainy-day reward.
okay: Tea's still a bit warm, so the ice is racing. Tasty though!
A touch strong on the tea. Very awake now!
Little light on lemon. Still a nice porch sip.
off: A warm iced tea! Brave little drink. Cozy on a gray day.
The ice melted out of politeness. Such good manners, this cup!
Mostly tea, a whisper of lemon. Nap-flavored. Thank you!

great: Caboose-red and full steam ahead!
You can taste real strawberries. Wonderful.
Sweet, tart, berry-bright. Perfect ride.
okay: A few berry chunks went rogue. I'll chew them happily.
Could use a bit more muddle. Still lovely!
More lemon than berry. A pink-ish caboose.
off: Soft and sweet. The strawberries must be napping. Sweet dreams!
A strawberry smoothie took a wrong turn and found me. Lucky me!
One whole strawberry, just floating. Like a little lifeboat! Here you go.

great: Cool mint, bright lemon. Like a breeze off the pond.
So fresh I can hear ducks. Perfect.
Just enough mint. You're a natural.
okay: Mint's a little shy. Still refreshing!
A bit leafy! I'm part garden now.
Strong mint! My nose feels very clean.
Extra ice! A frosty little adventure. Tasty!
off: Minty fresh! My smile is extra sparkly now. Fun!
The mint's off visiting the pond. Still sweet and sunny!
There's a whole leaf in my straw. We're friends now. Here you go!

great: Tiny cup, big hug. Perfect shot.
Crema like a little sunset. Wonderful.
Short, sweet, strong. Like a great nap in reverse.
okay: A touch quick on the pull. Still zippy!
Ends with a kick. Wakes me right up!
Light and lively. It's got spirit!
off: A very relaxed espresso. On vacation, maybe. I could use one too!
Strong enough to reorganize my bookshelf. Thank you!
A long shot! A really long shot. More espresso to love.

great: Honey, lavender, lemon. A garden in a glass.
Floral but not soapy. That's hard! Bravo.
Tastes like the market on a sunny Saturday.
okay: Lavender's a little loud today. Still pretty!
Honey sank to the bottom. Sweet treasure at the end.
Gentle and nice. Could steep a smidge longer.
off: Like sipping a sweet candle. My whole day smells nice now!
Lavender took the whole stage. Standing ovation anyway!
More honey than lemonade. The bees would be proud. Here you go!

great: Perfect foam, light as a library whisper.
Cocoa dust on a cloud. Wonderful.
Equal parts coffee, milk and foam. Textbook!
okay: Foam's a little thin, but it's cozy.
Cocoa-forward! I'm wearing a chocolate mustache now.
Nice! Slightly more latte than cappuccino today.
off: The foam slipped off to read a book. Can't blame it. Cozy cup!
Cocoa avalanche! I'm wearing it. Thank you!
It's flat, but it's trying its best. So am I. Here you go!

great: Chocolate and coffee best friends. Perfect.
Rich, warm, and the whip is a crown. Wonderful.
A snow day in a mug. Thank you!
okay: Little more chocolate than coffee. Not complaining!
Chocolate's hiding at the bottom. Stir and smile!
Bit sweet! My teeth waved hello.
off: Hot chocolate wearing a little coffee hat. Adorable and delicious!
The whip sank like a tiny ship. Brave whip. Here you go!
The chocolate's fashionably late. Meanwhile, a hopeful latte. Lovely!

great: Smooth cold brew, clinking ice. Perfect groove.
Cold, strong, not bitter. You nailed it.
Tastes like a record on a lazy afternoon.
okay: Lots of ice, lots of chill. What's there is tasty!
Mellows out at the end. Still chill!
Strong! I'm vibrating slightly. Happily.
off: An ice cube with big coffee dreams. I believe in it!
A warm iced coffee! Bold invention. Patent pending!
So much ice! Built-in refills as it melts. Clever!

great: Vanilla like a warm cookie. Lovely.
Sweet but balanced. A flower in a cup.
Silky, gentle, perfect. Thank you!
okay: Vanilla's a little shy today. Still cozy!
A tad sweet! Dessert came early.
Foam's a bit flat, flavor's lovely.
off: A vanilla candle's first draft. Smells like a hug!
The vanilla's hiding in the milk. Still warm, still kind.
Vanilla party! Everyone came. Here's your money, friend.

great: Tastes exactly like this time of year. Perfect.
The topping makes it. Seasonal magic!
Cozy, spiced, just right. I'll be back next season.
okay: Syrup's a little strong. Very festive though!
Topping slid off. It's on the saucer now. Fine!
Nice! The season's a bit faint in this one.
off: Several seasons at once. A whole year in one cup!
The topping went on a little adventure down the side. Cute!
Very mysterious flavor. Like a surprise gift. Thank you!

steve.great: Five staples out of five. Acquired with joy.
steve.okay: Three and a half staples. Solid binding.
steve.off: Two staples. But they're good staples. Here's exact change!

lamp_lady.okay: Soft lighting. A little dim, still pretty.
lamp_lady.off: Bit of a flicker in this one! I adore a fixer-upper. Paying!

keyclackr.okay: Linear. Smooth enough. 7/10, wuold sip again.
keyclackr.off: Lots of key chatter in this cup. Still a fan! Payign! Paying.

dottie.great: Oh, sweetie, that's just how Harold made it.
dottie.off: Warm-ish and made with love. Here's a little extra for trying, sweetie.

theo.okay: Vitals stable. Drink is fine. So am I.
theo.off: I've had worse at 4 a.m. Many times. Thank you, truly.

pippa.great: GOLD STAR. I'm writing this down.
pippa.off: You get the 'nice try' frog. He's very proud of you.

rocco.okay: Arrived a little dented, but it got here!
rocco.off: Return to sender? Nah, I'll keep it. Paid in full!

wren.great:
Warm between my palms
a small sun I can hold close
thank you, morning hands
wren.okay:
Almost there, just like
the first warm day of April.
Still, I'm glad of it.
wren.off:
Brave little cup, you
tried your best and so did I.
Here, for your effort.

neighbor_kid.great: Best. Lemonade. On the whole street!
neighbor_kid.okay: It's lemon-y AND sugar-y. Telling everyone.
neighbor_kid.off: Still lemonade! Lemonade is always good.

dana.great: Nailed it. Writing that one on the sticky note.
dana.okay: Not bad! Next one's even better.
dana.off: Okay, note to self: more lemon. Still proud.

priya_okafor.great: My usual, and somehow better. Purr-fect.
priya_okafor.okay: Just how I like it, give or take a whisker.
priya_okafor.off: Bit of a hairball day for this one, but I'm smiling!

biscuit.great: (Slow blink. A purr like a tiny engine.)
biscuit.okay: (Biscuit sniffs the cup and sits on your foot.)

cyclist_from_l3.great: Worth every puddle on the way here.
cyclist_from_l3.okay: Hit the spot. My socks disagree, but I don't.
cyclist_from_l3.off: Rain got in it? Fair. I'm half rain too. Cheers!

grandpa_train_shop.okay: Right on schedule. Good and sweet.
grandpa_train_shop.off: A little late to the station, but it arrived. Toot toot!

duckling.off: Quack? (it pats the cup with one webbed foot, kindly)

delbert_finch.off: Running a few seconds slow, as do I. Thank you kindly.

retiring_dentist.great: A flawless shot. I'd floss with joy.
retiring_dentist.okay: Good bite to it. No cavities detected.
retiring_dentist.off: A gentle little espresso. Very kind to the teeth!

npc_vendor.great: That's my honey singing in there!
npc_vendor.okay: Sweet and calm. Bees would approve.
npc_vendor.off: A bit shy on the honey. I'll bring you an extra jar!

npc_architect.great: Clean lines, perfect foam. I'd frame it.
npc_architect.off: A draft, not a final. Drafts are my favourite part!

agnes_pell.off: (whispering) A little loud, but so am I on Thursdays. Thank you.

juno_park.great: This mocha is a ten out of ten. Encore!
juno_park.okay: Solid groove. I'd play this one twice.
juno_park.off: A rough first take! Every great song starts with one.

record_store_owner.great: Pure groove. Iced coffee on vinyl.
record_store_owner.off: Off-beat, like all the best jazz. Love it.

rosa_pemberton.great: My usual, and it's in full bloom!
rosa_pemberton.off: Needs a little sun, like my ferns. Still lovely.

ray_pemberton.great: Best cup in town. Don't tell Rosa I said 'best'.
ray_pemberton.off: Gentle, the way my knees like it. Cheers, friend.

coworker_npc.off: A brave seasonal experiment! I respect it.

food_critic.great: (writes for a long time, then smiles) Remarkable.
food_critic.off: (gentle smile) Promising. I'll be back to see it grow.

marge_holloway.great: That's a mile-marker cup, kiddo. Proud of you.
marge_holloway.okay: Good work. Keep the wheels turning.
marge_holloway.off: Every road has a bump. You're doing fine.

latte.great: This foam is a pillow. Goodnight. Kidding. Thank you.

cappuccino.okay: Foam's a bit thin. Like my patience at hour eleven. Still lovely.

classic_lemonade.great: Look how the ice catches the light!
classic_lemonade.off: Soft sparkle today. I brought my own, so we're both glowing!

pink_lemonade.great: It's the exact color of my favorite lampshade!

classic_lemonade.off: One more lemon and it's gold-star! I'll make you a chart. Free!

strawberry_lemonade.great: Gold star AND a strawberry sticker. Rare!
strawberry_lemonade.off: Nice-try frog. He likes strawberries, so he's extra proud.

classic_lemonade.great: Coldest stop on my whole route!

mint_lemonade.great: Minty zing! Fastest block of the whole route now.

strawberry_lemonade.great: Signed, sealed, strawberry! Mint can take its time.
strawberry_lemonade.off: Bit squished in transit, but I'd sign for it again.

classic_lemonade.great: Harold's lemon tree would be proud.

mocha.great: Chocolate in my coffee! Harold would've called this cheating. Delicious cheating.

iced_coffee.great: Cold brew, clean actuation. Zero latency.
iced_coffee.off: Bit of input lag on the chill. Still smashing 'like'!

black_coffee.okay: Three and a half staples. Standard issue. Dependable.

espresso.great: Compact. Efficient. A mini stapler of a drink. Five staples.

latte.great:
Soft foam, like fresh snow
a little heart drawn in white
I'll keep this moment

honey_lavender_lemonade.great:
Lavender evening
honey settles like the dusk
lemon, the first star

black_coffee.great:
Dark and plain and warm
nothing extra, nothing missed
the morning, poured out
black_coffee.off:
Thin as early light
still, it found my hands. Thank you
for pouring the dawn
